tokenizer.membership: exact inherited eight programs over the same 512 genes; no new gene selection or membership search
tokenizer.normalization: per patient and filter: sum(W*x*measured)/sqrt(sum(W^2*measured)); zero norm returns exactly zero without epsilon amplification
tokenizer.rank1_energy_scope: equal Frobenius norm to I16; nominal expected energy match only for isotropic equal-variance filter responses; actual patient SD/rank must be measured
tokenizer.encoder: three modality-specific MLPs shared across eight programs: Linear(17,16),SiLU,Linear(16,32); append measured coverage as input17; add channel-program slot embedding
tokenizer.missing: identical inherited per-gene RNA/CNA masks; fully unmeasured tokens invalid and zero
tokenizer.legacy_L0: original Phase19 softmax scalar pooling plus coverage into three fresh Linear(2,16),SiLU,Linear(16,32) encoders and slots; L0 means legacy scalar, not L0 regularization
tokenizer.scope: sixteen filter coordinates are learned measurement directions, not sixteen semantic medical labels; actual rank can be below16

anchor.reference: inherited role/fold J0 all-input Ridge Cox
anchor.validation_or_test_risk: exact saved inherited simple.J0.risk; forward precomputed anchor override
anchor.scale: population SD(float64(X_fit) @ inherited_J0_weight_float64),ddof0; fit only; if zero both neural caps zero, no epsilon amplification
anchor.no_meta_stacking: no learned anchor coefficient, no new convex fit, no correction teacher from outer errors

base.architecture: fresh Phase19 A1 PO+PC+OC pairwise-logit sum and the same nonlinear message head architecture; own Clinical/Omics/visual always matched
base.scope: pairwise score terms followed by softmax and a joint head are not a strictly pairwise risk function

selective.kernel_evaluation: h0_pre=U_p*p+U_o*o+U_c*Cref;h0=tanh(h0_pre);h=tanh(h0_pre+U_c*(c-Cref)); algebraically same bias-free kernel, reference Clinical gives bitwise zero difference
selective.sparse_gate: clip(normalized_logit-tau,0,1),sum_valid_gate=.25*n_eligible; separate tau each attention normalization direction
selective.dense_gate: sigmoid(normalized_logit-tau),sum_valid_gate=.25*n_eligible; same per-direction mass budget, calibrated tau
selective.normalized_logit: per direction and eligible row: (raw_logit-row_mean)/max(population_row_SD,1e-6); same transform for sparse/dense; mean/SD remain differentiable; constant/empty rows safe
selective.zero_mass_rule: empty eligible support or M=0 returns a0 exactly; no division by zero
selective.messages: delta messages use (a1-a0) times the same matched values; aggregate with original valid query masks
selective.risk: .25*anchor_sd*tanh(bias_free_Linear(concatenated_delta_messages)); no trainable multiplier or further head after this cap
invariances: gate0 leaves that attention probability unchanged
selective.mass_not_cardinality: sumgate budget does not impose exactly25percent nonzero edges; realized support must be reported
selective.F16: only gate uses Cref; delta still uses matched Clinical minus Cref
selective.wrong_context: only correction-kernel context is mismatched; base attention, values, Clinical main and anchor remain the patient's own
selective.WO_eligibility: own token measured mask intersect donor measured token mask; missing donor tokens receive no correction; budget uses eligible count; support differences must be reported

arm_definitions.L0: legacy scalar tokenizer, fresh bounded base, frozen J0, no new correction; protocol bridge rather than historical checkpoint reuse
arm_definitions.P1: signed16 filters through fixed energy-normalized rank1 map; no correction
arm_definitions.P16: same signed16 filters through I16; no correction
arm_definitions.S1: rank1 tokens plus selective capped-simplex gate and bounded correction
arm_definitions.S16: rank16 tokens plus selective capped-simplex gate and bounded correction
arm_definitions.D16: same rank16 correction but logistic dense gate with exactly matched gate mass
arm_definitions.F16: same rank16 selective correction; gate uses Cref, delta remains patient-conditioned
arm_definitions.WC16: S16 trained/evaluated with partition-local wrong Clinical only in new correction kernel
arm_definitions.WO16: S16 trained/evaluated with partition-local wrong Omics only in new correction kernel; eligible intersection disclosed

training.objective: complete patient risk-set Efron Cox; frozen J0 has no optimizer or trainable stacking coefficient
training.selection: inner validation complete Efron loss EMA; all135 inner selections locked before any outer refit; fresh outer exact selected epochs
training.full_risk_gradient: nonreentrant checkpoint with preserved dropout RNG; one complete patient risk vector and exact Efron backward, never microbatch Cox

inference_controls: frozen S16; wrongC,wrongO,constantC,correction_off alter only new correction; preserve own base and anchor; these are not retrained WC16/WO16

bootstrap.sampling: one within-outer-fold patient-count matrix shared across every model and algorithm seed; fixed trained models, no risk ensemble

decision_rules.directional: each core contrast in both Harrell and Uno60 has mean_delta>0 and >=2/3 positive algorithm seeds; operator/cap technical checks and participating-arm optimization budget pass
decision_rules.statistical_support: corresponding primary Bonferroni14 lower limits positive; directional success alone is not statistical confirmation
decision_rules.practical: S16 minus each of J0/J_CS has nonnegative mean delta in both metrics; report paired intervals separately; no requirement that DID be positive
decision_rules.axes_independent: A, B, DID and practical are separate outputs; never require B/DID for A, never substitute A direction for practical gain
decision_rules.budget_unresolved: mark affected axis BUDGET_UNRESOLVED rather than interpreting censored optimization as no information; completed negative/unresolved results remain publishable

selectivity_behavior_gate.aggregation: each eligible>=2 query support(g>1e-6)/nEligible; query mean within WSI, equal WSI mean within patient, equal all-fit-patient mean; median across15 selected inner checkpoints independently each direction; both strictly below.75
selectivity_behavior_gate.retain_degeneracy: also report all-base-query support, eligible<2 fraction, raw-score populationSD<=1e-6 rate and valid row/WSI/patient counts; no label-conditioned row removal
selectivity_behavior_gate.interpretation: A selective-mechanism claim requires this behavior gate plus A performance/seed/budget/technical gates; failure does not block publishing actual performance or negate all Clinical modulation
selectivity_behavior_gate.actual_mass_matching: equal unweighted sumgate does not equate M=sum(a0*gate), TV/(rho*M), or final correction SD; all three reported, no claim of matched realized correction

diagnostics.population: all fit patients, no label-conditioned sampling; chunked anonymous map/token/risk summaries, raw maps not persisted
diagnostics.input_gradients: eight fixed evenly spaced fit patient indices, de-duplicated; exact patient/WSI unions audited privately and reported only as counts

fullOmicsWrong.scope: replace interaction R/G/L/masks with donor; own visual/Clinical/frozen main; frozen sensitivity only, not retrained

uniformPair.scope: replace both base attention directions with uniform over valid candidates; tokens and values unchanged; frozen sensitivity only, not retrained

required: projection gate mass and actual nonzero support
row probability/TV/invariance and final risk cap
correction risk relative to frozen anchor and bounded base
diagnostics.no_morphology_truth: attention maps and pathway filters are not independent pathology annotations

endpoints.secondary: PFI transfer of frozen DSS risks only; no PFI training, epoch selection or endpoint switching

literature_scope: reuse known gated attention/sparse mappings and pathway-vector tokenization ideas; capped mass-redistribution operator and signed filters are explicitly audited adaptations, not first attention/FiLM/pathway semantics claims
scope: two finite exploratory mechanisms on the repeatedly developed TCGA cohort; no untouched external confirmation, no extra RNA-only or distillation leaderboard
privacy: patient OOF, raw risks/maps, weights, identifiers, selected gene lists, donor indices, PCA/token states and credentials remain private; publish only new source/config and anonymous aggregate reports
after_matrix: stop at270 formal neural fits; diagnose observed failure without automatic rank/depth/gate/scale/endpoint expansion
